def transform(grid):
    # Find the distinctive long L-shaped component; its color is the paint color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(r.count(c) for r in grid))
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append((col,pts))
    # The paint object is the largest thin L: long vertical and horizontal arms.
    paint=None; marker=None
    for col,pts in comps:
      ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
      hh=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; ww=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
      if len(pts)>=8 and (hh>=5 and ww>=4) and len(pts) <= hh+ww:
        paint=col; marker=pts; break
    if paint is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Recolor a small L-shaped object that has the same handed orientation
    # as the long marker, preferring a 3-cell elbow.
    candidates=[]
    for col,pts in comps:
      if col==paint: continue
      ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
      hh=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; ww=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
      if len(pts)==3 and hh==2 and ww==2:
        candidates.append((col,pts))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if candidates:
      # target has an elbow; marker direction: vertical arm and horizontal arm
      # identify corner orientation from marker bbox and select matching elbow if possible
      my=[p[0] for p in marker]; mx=[p[1] for p in marker]
      top,left=min(my),min(mx); bottom,right=max(my),max(mx)
      # Marker has vertical arm at left/right, horizontal arm at top/bottom.
      corner=(bottom,left) if (bottom,left) in marker else (bottom,right)
      want='bl' if corner==(bottom,left) else 'br'
      for col,pts in candidates:
        y0=min(y for y,x in pts); x0=min(x for y,x in pts)
        s={(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in pts}
        ori='bl' if {(0,0),(1,0),(1,1)}==s else ('br' if {(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}==s else '')
        if ori==want:
          for y,x in pts: out[y][x]=paint
          return out
      col,pts=candidates[0]
      for y,x in pts: out[y][x]=paint
    return out
